+Throttle limits: the engine is either off or between `throttle_min` and 1.
+Commanded thrust below the floor snaps to the nearer of off / minimum. If the
+minimum thrust exceeds hover weight (throttle_min above about 0.27 at the end
+of the burn) the lander cannot hover, so the terminal phase pulses the engine
+and cuts it below `cutoff_alt`. Tuned and tested up to throttle_min = 0.3; at
+0.4 and above the braking arc cannot reach the gate (needs a pulsed/dithered
+throttle model).
